# PromptCrafter AI

> PromptCrafter AI is a browser-based prompt engineering workbench. Users describe a task and it generates a structured, role-aware system prompt, then supports conversational refinement, immutable versioning, live testing against configured models, and quality scoring across six rubric dimensions. The app is local-first: sessions and provider settings are stored in the browser, and users bring their own model API keys through a built-in Gemini integration or any OpenAI-compatible provider. It has no accounts and no backend database.
